research_description: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Charusluk Viphavakit's research focuses on optical sensing technologies, functional nanomaterials, and advanced polymeric materials for a wide range of applications. Her work integrates optical fiber and photonic sensing principles with nanostructured materials, surface functionalization, and molecular recognition techniques to develop sensitive and selective sensing platforms. These technologies are applied to chemical and biological detection, non-invasive health monitoring, food quality and safety, and environmental monitoring. Her research also extends to the design and fabrication of advanced polymeric biomaterials, including hydrogel- and silicone-based artificial intraocular lenses for biomedical and veterinary applications.

Dr. Porpin Pungetmongkol's research focuses on nano-enabled electrochemical sensing and the fabrication and synthesis of functional nanomaterials for diverse applications. Building on her early work in label-free electrical detection of single DNA molecules using nanogap electrodes and impedance spectroscopy, she now develops low-cost sensors enhanced with a range of nanomaterials, including copper oxide nanorods, gold nanoparticles, graphene, and carbon quantum dots, many of which are produced from inexpensive or waste-derived sources. These sensors target non-invasive clinical diagnostics, such as sweat glucose and creatinine monitoring for chronic kidney disease, as well as environmental monitoring, with smartphone-based readout for point-of-care use. Her overall aim is to develop cutting-edge nanomaterials and translate them into affordable, portable analytical tools for healthcare and environmental applications.

name_th: อนงค์นาฏ สมหวังธนโรจน์
research_interests: My research focuses on materials innovation for real-world impact, spanning polymer engineering, sustainable packaging, and energy-related materials. I work on functional polymers for electronics packaging, biodegradable and active packaging materials to extend fresh produce shelf life, and translational innovations developed during crisis contexts such as reusable respirators and protective materials. More recently, my interests include materials and systems for electrochemical energy storage, particularly zinc-based batteries, with an emphasis on scalability, sustainability, and industry–academic collaboration.

name_th: อาทิวรรณ โชติพฤกษ์
research_interests: My research focuses on production of biofuels and bio-based chemicals in which green technology, such as supercritical and subcritical fluid technology, is applied to extraction of natural compounds and conversion of biomass into high value-added products to benefit the society.

name_th: บรรเจิด จงสมจิตร
research_interests: My research focuses on heterogeneous catalysis including: (i) catalytic ethanol transformation into other value-added products such as ethylene, diethyl ether, acetaldehyde, butanol, etc., (ii) development of polymerization catalysts such as Ziegler-Natta and metallocene catalysts for olefin polymerization, and (iii) methanol synthesis via CO and CO2 hydrogenation over copper-based catalysts.

name_th: จูงใจ ปั้นประณต
research_interests: My research focuses on synthesis of heterogeneous catalysts (supported metal, metal oxide, zeolite, layered double hydroxide) with tailored properties via different methods such as flame spray pyrolysis, strong electrostatic adsorption, electroless deposition, solvothermal, magnetron sputtering, etc., for many catalytic reactions (selective hydrogenation, lignocellulose conversion, CO/CO2 hydrogenation, selective oxidation of H2S, olefin metathesis, propane dehydrogenation). The catalyst structure/activity-selectivity relationship is determined based on numerous analytic results from bulk and molecular level characterization.

name_th: เหมือนเดือน พิศาลพงศ์
research_interests: My research focuses on the natural polymer processing and surface modification. Research interest includes technologies/processes for the development of biomaterials/biopolymer composites for applications in biomedical areas, green catalysis, agriculture, packaging and electronics.

name_th: สุทธิชัย อัสสะบำรุงรัตน์
research_interests: My research focuses on application of process intensification and multifunctional reactors for Chemical, Petrochemical and Biorefinery Industries. I have applied this concept to several systems such as production of hydrogen, biodiesel, bio-hydrogenated diesel and bio based chemicals and CO2 conversion to valuable chemicals.

name_th: วรงค์ ปวราจารย์
research_interests: My research background is in the synthesis of inorganic materials, especially nanomaterials, via various techniques. Examples include fabrication of flexible ceramic nanofibers by electrospinning. My work has shifted toward incorporation of nanostructured materials in micro-scaled channel for various applications and the use of microchannel to investigate reaction mechanisms.

name_th: ศุภฤกษ์ ประเสริฐธรรม
research_interests: Dr. Supareak’s works in the High-performance Computing Unit (CECC-HCU) focuses on the use of Density Functional Theory-based analysis, Microkinetic Modelling, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and Chemical Process Simulations for the screening of reactive and stable catalysts. We applied our own theory, ‘the ratings concept’ for such a screening process, where the techniques can be applied to processes in chemical engineering involving reactors for the on-line optimization of the catalyst during operation. In addition, our team works hand in hand with the experimental team from the Center of Excellence on Catalysis and Catalytic Reaction Engineering (CECC), Department of Chemical Engineering, Chulalongkorn University to provide insight on what happened on the catalyst surface and propose the guideline towards the design of reactive and stable catalysts in a bottom-up fashion.

name_th: ปิยะสาร ประเสริฐธรรม
research_interests: More than 30 years after the founding of the Center of Excellence on Catalysis and Catalytic Reaction Engineering (CECC), I have been involved in industrial catalyst design connecting theoretical academic concepts to the needs of the petrochemical industry.

name_th: อมรชัย อาภรณ์วิชานพ
research_interests: My research on process systems engineering involves the development and application of theoretical and computational tools for modeling, design, simulation, optimization, and control of complex chemical and energy-related systems. Current research projects cover the area of fuel cells, hydrogen and renewable energy technologies, energy storage, process intensification, and biorefinery.

name_th: กษิดิศ หนูทอง
research_interests: My recent works focus on (1) microalgal cultivation in various photobioreactor designs and operations to produce high value biorefinery products as well as the production of live feed for aquaculture hatchery, and (2) optimizing microbial process for agri-and agro-industrial waste reutilization. I also work, to lesser extent, on topics such as algal biomass separation and solvent extraction and antibiotic removal from wastewater using hollow fiber supported liquid membrane.

name_th: ภัทรพร คิม-โล่ห์สุนทร
research_interests: My research focuses on CO2 conversion to higher value products such as methanol, other chemicals, and carbon products. Research interest includes electrochemical devices for energy applications, with a particular focus on fuel cells and electrolyzer.

name_th: สุรเทพ เขียวหอม
research_interests: My research focuses on the development of next-generation batteries such as zinc-air, zinc-ion, and zinc-iodine batteries.

name_th: โศรดา กนกพานนท์

name_th: ปารวี วาศน์อำนวย
research_interests: My research focuses on the area of fabrication of nanomaterials for a variety of solar energy-related applications. The main research studies focus on fabrication of various nanostructured materials, control of associated parameters to achieve desired morphology and structure and desired optical and electrical properties, and development of solar energy conversion into other forms of energy, e.g. heat and electricity, and as a photocatalyst based on fabricated nanomaterials.

Bioactive compounds purification: crystallization and molecular distillation

research_interests: My research interest involves the synthesis and development of membranes based on polymeric and composite materials. We carefully design and tailor a membrane to serve specific applications such as water purification, desalination, energy storage, gas separation and industrial product separation.

name_th: พลัง บำรุงสกุลสวัสดิ์
research_interests: My research focuses on scale-up of electrochemical reactors for industrial-scale applications and also integration of electrochemical reactions in conventional processes. Current research includes in situ electrochemical generation of methoxide for biodiesel production and scale-up of electrochemical reactors for CO2 conversion.

The work can be categorized into developing continuous-flow processes for challenging chemical and biochemical reactions, designing novel bioprocesses and sustainable processes, and improving separation techniques such as membrane technology and high-pressure extraction.

research_interests: My research focuses on unit design, optimization, and scale up using computational fluid dynamic (CFD) modeling. Research interest includes purification and separation processes, renewable energy production and storage, heat transfer and ventilation systems, and dispersed multiphase flows.

name_th: อัครวัต ศิริสุข
research_interests: My research interest involves synthesis of nanoparticles for use as photocatalysts, including photocatalytic conversion of carbon dioxide to value-added chemicals such as methane and methanol, and hydrogen evolution by splitting water. We improve production yield by modifying photocatalysts with transition metals or oxides and by creating composites with 2D materials.

name_th: กริชชาติ ว่องไวลิขิต
research_interests: My primary research revolves around carbon capture and utilization for decarbonization and carbon neutrality. I also study chemical process simulation and techno-economic analysis, and use computational fluid dynamics to understand fluid behavior in industrial processes.

name_th: เมริกา ฉันทานุมัติอาภรณ์
research_interests: My research experiences focus on energy conversion devices and technologies, particularly fuel cells, electrolysis and thermophotovoltaics. The research ranges from development of materials for fuel cells to visualization of oxide ions in oxides and nanofabrication techniques. My current interests also include production of hydrogen from renewable feedstocks.

name_th: พฤทธิ์ ประเสริฐเจริญสุข
research_interests: My research interests are in alternative energy, advanced thermochemical conversion (pyrolysis and gasification), waste-to-energy and sustainable hydrogen production. Current research also focuses on alternative hydrogen storage materials, including carbon-based materials, metal-organic frameworks (MOF) and polyoxometalates (POM) for light-duty fuel cell vehicles.

name_th: มนัญญา โอฆวิไล
research_interests: My research primarily focuses on development of porous separators, polymer electrolytes, and electrodes for advanced energy storage systems, including zinc-ion, zinc-air, and zinc-iodine batteries, and electrolyzers for sustainable hydrogen production. My research also extends to polymer-based medical devices such as strain sensors, PM2.5 filter masks, and drug-release membranes.
